parameter_accounting.architecture: LayerNorm(6) -> Linear(6,32) -> SiLU -> Linear(32,256), final layer zero-initialized

training_cost.budgeted_critical_coverage: reuses existing teacher exact-critical labels and straight-through HAB mask; no additional teacher/model forward
training_cost.adapter: small residual branch; expected compute overhead negligible relative to scene transformer and atom-action scoring

evaluation_cost.raw_score_decision_contract: adds small queried-feature/value comparison arrays only during evaluation/audit
evaluation_cost.support_contract_audit: one preflight same-checkpoint suite; reusable when checkpoint/config/code fingerprints are fresh

cache_strategy.runtime_work: compute only 6-D extension online for verified-prefix path
cache_strategy.fallback: automatically use full runtime recompute if prefix audit is not PASS
cache_strategy.correctness_priority: cache acceleration is never allowed to bypass raw/score/decision contract checks

deployment_budget.note: No speedup is obtained by shrinking B, reducing valid action coverage, or deleting safety candidates.

performance_boundary: No GPU wall-clock benchmark was available here. The report describes structural overhead only and does not claim a measured speedup.
